output.summary: A new test covers half-up rounding in formatPrice, alongside build and tooling config changes: a Node 22 CI runtime, a coverage-enabled test script with a patch version bump, and a stricter TypeScript indexed-access check. The config changes look independent of the test addition.

groups.title: New half-up rounding test for formatPrice
groups.description: Adds a test expecting 0.125 to format as 0.13. Check that formatPrice actually rounds half up here, since floating-point representation can affect this case.

groups.title: Test script runs with coverage
groups.description: The test script now passes --coverage and the version is bumped to 1.0.1. Check that a coverage provider is installed, because only vitest is listed as a dependency, and that the bump is intended.

groups.title: CI uses Node 22
groups.description: The workflow moves from Node 20 to 22. Confirm that the project and its dependencies support Node 22.

groups.title: Stricter TypeScript indexed access
groups.description: Enables noUncheckedIndexedAccess, which looks unrelated to the other edits. Check that existing code still type-checks under it.
